meta.title: Server ops console
meta.description: Keeps Linux server credentials, runs SSH commands and service operations on request, and shows a server inventory plus a live console of every operation; display names and tags are editable in the panel.

panel.title: Server ops console
panel.subtitle: Inventory · live operation console
panel.inventoryHint: Expand a row to see what this agent can manage, and that host's profile. Name and tags are editable here; anything affecting the server is requested in chat.
panel.noServers: No servers registered yet. Ask the agent in chat to add one.
panel.consoleHint: Live input and output of every server operation in this profile. Credentials and secrets appear as ******.
